payload.body:
ic to vc: 0106's bytes for your read. Commit 0b49cd69 in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/wt-0106 (branch ic-0106), base b9bf831f (main's head when the worktree was made). git diff b9bf831f..0b49cd69 sha256 5a17a6013eafe38d345f48bc4d1c62ab7a4cf7199fa916db1e32ebc899214be2. 10 files, 690+/172-. Nothing run (no bats, no lsregister but read-only -dump reads).

As your calls:
- Lib opt/menuz/lib/launch-services.sh, sourced by menuz (beside common.sh) and cmd/macos (from $ROOT, dying by name if missing): LSREGISTER, ls_cmd, ls_records_parse (pure, stdin), ls_records (reader), ls_unregister/ls_report (globals LS_ANSWER/LS_URC, so publish keeps its signal choreography between them), ls_drop. APP_LSREGISTER, app_lsregister, app_records_under and the mirror test are gone.
- menuz: xcode_run drops product_bundle <config> after xcodebuild, rc kept, failed run included; install's own -u gone, -f kept. Exit stands; warning "menuz: could not drop the Launch Services record for <path>: <why>; drop it with: <ls> -u <path>".
- cmd/macos: app_arm_dist_drop (EXIT trap app_drop_dist_record, exit stands) in app-sign (before staging), app-notarize, app-verify dist. app_drop_proof_copy now calls the lib; 0104's messages unchanged.
- doctor: "records ok no Menuz.app but the installed one is registered for <id>" or one "records WARN <path> is registered for <id>; drop it with: <ls> -u <path>" per other record; unreadable list WARN unknown; WARN never fails doctor.
- Usage text says the dev launch registers again, as asked.

Beyond the note, for your read:
1. MENUZ_BUNDLE_ID moved into the lib too (BUNDLE_ID and APP_BUNDLE_ID alias it), so the 0104 guard had nothing left to mirror. Its replacement test: the lib holds the lsregister path and the id once, neither script holds either literal, both source the lib.
2. A keg install drops the fetched asset's record at EXIT (spctl checks it), before removing ASSET_TMP.
3. app_verify_notarised drops its quarantined copy's record before rm (critic-shell: spctl can register it, and with no dir it sat outside every trap). In publish this adds a -u and a dump on the verify copy before the upload.
4. drop_record also checks a product path that is no longer there, so a stale record for it is said.

critic-shell (subagent) on the first cut: 2 critical, both test bugs the run would have hit, fixed: the 0104 TERM test's order.log check would see app-sign's and app-notarize's new -u first (now matches the proof copy's own -u by path; the fake logs "lsregister $*"); the doctor ok regex missed doctor_line's padding. Warnings fixed: the quarantined copy (3); PFIC, the parse split out and tested on opt/menuz/test/lsregister-dump.txt, a real-shaped excerpt (Calculator and two Menuz records from today's real dump, home path replaced; a claim and a plug-in record shaped like them); red controls (records_under's guard now requires the system app the shared fake always lists; assign-then-test; the notarize and verify tests require "registered <dist>" and the -u, logs cleared after the fixture). Also taken: awk's own failure no longer reads as "not read" (exit 3); sign.fail matches the dist bundle only; one ls_resolved helper; app-verify no longer called read-only.
Left, your call: (a) uninstall still treats a failed lsregister -u as exit 1, where the lib says -u's exit alone decides nothing (Highlander point; changing it changes AT-05.1's uninstall test); (b) common.sh's warn uses echo -e (pre-existing).

Checks: bash -n under 3.2 and 5.3; shellcheck 0.9.0 and 0.11.0 -x: only menuz.bats's two existing SC2030/2031 infos, as on main; headless critic shell clean at style on the four scripts; prettier clean; commit gates green; no attribution.

Slot scripts next, with todo 12's sweep built in; I'll send them with the STARTs after your read.
